method: the source's lean muscular body (macroMuscle 1, macroWeight -1) minus its lean average-muscle body (macroWeight -1), built through this basis, along the neutral's normals; band-passed on the surface by uniform-Laplacian heat diffusion (the fine field after HIGH sweeps less the broad field after LOW sweeps); faded to zero within FADE metres of the nipple fill's centres (recovered from the neutral's vanishing uniform bilaplacian) and of the crotch cut on the midline; stepping aside where an authored relief endpoint carves (abs, deltoids, scapula); split over the breast mound (the source cupsize endpoint's normalized, smoothed displacement) into its own channel; made exactly bilaterally symmetric in the field and in the normals; stored at 10 µm
